Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Adds the AetherPress logo to the installed plugin manifest so it displays correctly in xlplugins.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Freshly installed animation mods now activate without a manual Penumbra toggle. Group animations play once and run lobby-only EmoteSync six seconds later. Adds manual EmoteSync, Simple Heels Temp Offset, and Livepose controls.
